title: Swim Metric3 Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Swim.com workouts (`swimcom:workout`), MySwimPro sessions (`myswimpro:session`), pool lap logs (`pool:lap`), and swim meet results (`swim:meet`).
app: Swim.com workout exports, MySwimPro session logs, pool lap counters, swim meet results, and interval pace trackers forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=swim:metric3
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for swim metric3 (3) data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate swim metric3 (3) events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It scores how your swim metric3 (3) activity added up each month instead of day by day.
